Compare resources between two stored cost snapshots

## Synopsis

```text
Read stored cost history without running a plan. Terraform directories resolve the current project identity without --stack; --include-workspace opts into workspace scoping. Pulumi histories use --stack.
```

```text
finfocus cost history diff [flags]
```

## Examples

```bash
  finfocus cost history diff --stack dev --from v35 --to v42
  finfocus cost history diff --stack dev --from 2025-03-15 --output json
```

## Options

```text
      --from string         Start snapshot: version (v35) or date (YYYY-MM-DD)
  -h, --help[=true|false]   help for diff
      --output string       Output format: table, json (default "table")
      --threshold float     Hide changes at or below this monthly amount
      --to string           End snapshot: version or date (default: latest)
```
